# Copilot Instructions

Read `AGENTS.md` before making project-wide suggestions or edits.

StaffSmith is a React + Vite TypeScript app. Keep parser logic in `src/music/parser`, score types in `src/music/model`, MusicXML generation in `src/music/musicxml`, and OpenSheetMusicDisplay rendering code in `src/features/renderer`.

Use `pnpm build` for type/build verification and `pnpm lint` for linting.
